body.name: Adaptive singularity-to-oracle handle
body.construction: Design \(\mathsf H_n\) by combining the undivided confidence region \(\mathcal C_n^{\mathrm{inv}}\) on data-detected neighborhoods of zero coefficient changes or vanishing branch and basis margins with the numerical-delta intervals \(\mathcal I_{q,n}^{\mathrm{ND}}\) on separated regular cells; determine the switching thresholds from simultaneous \(\widetilde\Omega_n\)-studentized primitive-moment, ratio-order, branch-margin, slack, and reduced-cost tests.
